notes._summary:
Approved cmark-gfm 0.29.0.gfm.13 baseline measured against Supramark's DEFAULT parser config (issue #144 premise), with a per-section `--no-gfm-autolink` toggle for the CommonMark-core spec.txt sections (issue #203). cmark-gfm's own spec.txt run executes the CommonMark-core sections (those not suffixed `(extension)`) WITHOUT the autolink extension; the gate mirrors that, so bare URLs/emails in those sections stay literal. GFM extension cases — the `(extension)` sections and the entire extensions.txt file — keep the default config with the autolink extension ON. Issue #203 resolved the 4 CommonMark-core Autolinks cases (spec-0610/0616/0619/0620) this way; the parallel commonmark-source divergences (0602/0608/0611/0612) are resolved under issue #202. The renderer/parser fixes in this baseline (GFM table thead/tbody + align attribute, task-list trailing-space normalization via shared list-child renderer, GFM bare-URL/email autolink postprocess with image-alt and code-node skipping, GFM single+double-tilde strikethrough, embedded-HTML-in-table-cell via coherent inline-to-HTML serialization, GFM tagfilter for the Disallowed Raw HTML / HTML tag filter sections, the GFM footnote section renderer under options.gfmFootnoteStyle, footnote-definition indented-continuation capture in the Rust parser, HTML5 minimized boolean-attribute emission for footnote ref/backref/section attributes (ext-0023/ext-0024), footnote-reference reassembly across inline raw-HTML splits (ext-0025, which also closes an XSS vector where a `<…>` inside a footnote-ref label rendered as a raw tag), strong-in-strong wrapper suppression mirroring cmark-gfm's html.c CMARK_NODE_STRONG rule so that `****foo****` flattens to a single `foo` instead of the nested `foo` the delimiter-run algorithm produces — fixing spec-0398/0426/0434/0435/0436/0473/0474/0475/0477, and cross-block active-formatting-element reconstruction for paragraphs with unclosed inline formatting tags (spec-0652), where the paragraph and following serializable raw siblings fold into one RawHtml fragment so a single browser parse reproduces cmark's verbatim-output reconstruction) resolve every other semantic / visual case. The crash-safety case extensions-0020 (`(_A_@_.A`) has `` as its expected HTML in cmark-gfm's test file — a sentinel that test/spec_tests.py auto-passes without comparing. Rather than skip it, the conformance runner compares Supramark against the cmark-gfm 0.29.0.gfm.13 binary's (587a12bb) real HTML output for that input (`

This shouldn't crash everything: (A@_.A

`), captured in lib/expected-overrides.mjs since CI has no cmark binary. Supramark matches. No failures remain.
notes.cmark-gfm-0.29.0.gfm.13-spec-0610: Autolinks: RESOLVED (issue #203) — CommonMark-core bare-URL case expects literal output. The gate now parses CommonMark-core spec.txt sections with `--no-gfm-autolink`, mirroring cmark-gfm's own spec.txt run, so the bare URL stays literal. Kept out of the failure list; note retained for traceability.
notes.cmark-gfm-0.29.0.gfm.13-spec-0616: Autolinks: RESOLVED (issue #203) — CommonMark-core bare-email case expects literal output. Parsed with `--no-gfm-autolink` per the CommonMark-core section toggle; the bare email stays literal. Kept out of the failure list; note retained for traceability.
notes.cmark-gfm-0.29.0.gfm.13-spec-0619: Autolinks: RESOLVED (issue #203) — CommonMark-core invalid bracketed autolink whose inner bare URL must stay literal. Parsed with `--no-gfm-autolink` per the CommonMark-core section toggle. Kept out of the failure list; note retained for traceability.
notes.cmark-gfm-0.29.0.gfm.13-spec-0620: Autolinks: RESOLVED (issue #203) — CommonMark-core invalid bracketed autolink whose inner bare email must stay literal. Parsed with `--no-gfm-autolink` per the CommonMark-core section toggle. Kept out of the failure list; note retained for traceability.
notes.spec-0652:
Disallowed Raw HTML: RESOLVED — the web renderer now folds a paragraph that carries unclosed inline formatting tags (``/``) together with its following serializable raw siblings into one RawHtml fragment, so the browser's tree-construction reproduces cmark-gfm's verbatim-output active-formatting-element reconstruction across the `

` boundary in a single parse (the blockquote text ends up wrapped in the reconstructed ``). Kept in no failure list; note retained for traceability.
notes.extensions-0020:
Autolinks: RESOLVED — `(_A_@_.A` is a cmark-gfm crash-safety edge case whose expected HTML in the test file is the `` sentinel (auto-passed by test/spec_tests.py, never compared). Rather than skip it, the conformance runner compares Supramark against the cmark-gfm 0.29.0.gfm.13 binary's (587a12bb) real HTML output for this input — `

This shouldn't crash everything: (A@_.A

` — captured in lib/expected-overrides.mjs (CI has no cmark binary). Supramark produces byte-identical output, so the case passes both the semantic and visual comparison with no skip. Kept in no failure list; note retained for traceability.
notes.extensions-0025: Footnotes: RESOLVED — the Rust parser now reassembles a `[^label]` whose label contains `<` (raw HTML) as one footnote reference instead of letting the inline raw-HTML rule split it, so the label is percent-encoded into the href/backref ids rather than the embedded tag leaking into the output (which also closed an XSS vector). Kept in no failure list; note retained for traceability.
notes.spec-0398: Emphasis: RESOLVED — the web renderer suppresses the inner wrapper when a strong node's parent is also strong, mirroring cmark-gfm 0.29.0.gfm.13's html.c CMARK_NODE_STRONG rule, so `__foo, __bar__, baz__` flattens to `foo, bar, baz`. CommonMark 0.31 does NOT flatten (its spec keeps the nesting), so the behavior is opt-in via `options.flattenNestedStrong`; the cmark-gfm conformance harness enables it, the default stays nested. Kept in no failure list; note retained for traceability. (Same fix resolves spec-0426/0434/0435/0436/0473/0474/0475/0477.)
